title: Creatures of the South Bay: 40 Animals & Pets
dek: Pelicans, harbor seals, gray whales and garibaldi, plus the town's pets, robo-pets and orbit creatures from Signal Over the South Bay. Every entry is tagged REAL or INVENTED.

body:
The animal half of the Signal Over the South Bay field guide: 40 creatures, each on its own jet-age field-guide card.

Nineteen are real South Bay wildlife: brown pelicans, harbor seals and sea lions, bottlenose and common dolphins, gray whales on their winter migration, garibaldi, leopard sharks, snowy plovers and least terns on the sand, great blue herons and Belding's savannah sparrows in the Ballona marsh, peregrine falcons, Allen's hummingbirds, red-tailed hawks, coyotes, opossums and the western fence lizard.

Twenty-one are invented for the comic's world and tagged that way. Ten are town pets, including Mach, Capt. Della Marsh's beagle, and Sputnik, Rusty Vance's tool-belt tabby. Seven are robo-pets and companion drones, like a paper-delivery drone shaped like a gull. Four are orbit creatures that drift around the Lantern.

Pets link to their owners in the cast of 100, and every animal links to the habitats and plants it depends on in the guide.

Meet them all in the animals section of /features/signal-over-the-south-bay/field-guide/. The data is also published as animals.json.
